s0001.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the dingmao new moon, Tan Prefecture was taken; Song pacification commissioner Li Fei burned his entire household and died.
s0001.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, on the dingmao new moon of the first month of spring, Tan Prefecture fell; Song pacification commissioner Li Fei burned his whole household and perished.

s0002.literal: Ala Haiya separately dispatched officials to summon those not yet submitted; within ten days Hunan prefectures and districts surrendered in succession, yielding one superior prefecture, six prefectures, two armies, forty counties, 561,112 households, and 1,537,740 persons.
s0002.idiomatic: Ala Haiya sent officials out separately to win over those not yet submitted; within ten days Hunan prefectures and districts surrendered one after another, yielding one superior prefecture, six prefectures, two armies, forty counties, 561,112 households, and 1,537,740 persons.

s0003.literal: Bayan's army halted at Jiaxing Prefecture; pacification commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.
s0003.idiomatic: Bayan's army halted at Jiaxing Prefecture, and pacification commissioner Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.

s0004.literal: Dong Wenbing's army halted at Zhapu; Song controller Liu Ying surrendered with his command.
s0004.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing's army halted at Zhapu; Song controller Liu Ying surrendered with his command.

s0005.literal: On xinwei day Dong Wenbing's army reached Haiyan; county magistrate Wang Yuxian, Ganpu garrison controller Hu Quan, and Fujian Circuit infantry and cavalry commander Shen Shilong all surrendered.
s0005.idiomatic: On xinwei day Dong Wenbing's army reached Haiyan; county magistrate Wang Yuxian, Ganpu garrison controller Hu Quan, and Fujian Circuit infantry and cavalry commander Shen Shilong all surrendered.

s0006.literal: On renshen day the General Inspectorate Office was renamed the Communications Bureau, with Uryangqadai and others placed in charge.
s0006.idiomatic: On renshen day the General Inspectorate Office was renamed the Communications Bureau, with Uryangqadai and others placed in charge.

s0007.literal: Exchange treasuries were established in the circuits, eleven in all, managing market exchange of currency, silks, and other goods.
s0007.idiomatic: Exchange treasuries were set up in the circuits, eleven in all, to manage market exchange of currency, silks, and other goods.

s0008.literal: An edict ordered the Dadu circuit general administration in government hire and government purchase to share levies equally between powerful families and common people.
s0008.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Dadu circuit general administration that in government hire and government purchase, powerful families and common people were to share levies equally.

s0009.literal: On guiyou day Song grand councilor Chen Yizhong dispatched Director of the Armory Works Liu Tingrui bearing the Song sovereign's memorial declaring vassalage to the army front to report and discuss, and also sent a letter from Yizhong and others to Bayan; Bayan replied in writing.
s0009.idiomatic: On guiyou day Song grand councilor Chen Yizhong sent Director of the Armory Works Liu Tingrui with the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front for consultation, and also sent Yizhong's letter to Bayan; Bayan answered in writing.

s0010.literal: On yihai day an edict summoned Sichuan commissioner Zhao Dingying to court.
s0010.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict summoned Sichuan commissioner Zhao Dingying to court.

s0011.literal: Hunter households in Dadu and other circuits were relocated to garrison east of Great Hong Mountain; seal keeper Dong Wenzhong requested that the poor and sick not be moved — granted.
s0011.idiomatic: Hunter households in Dadu and other circuits were relocated to garrison east of Great Hong Mountain; seal keeper Dong Wenzhong asked that the poor and sick be exempted from relocation, and the request was granted.

s0012.literal: Song again dispatched investigating censor Liu Bi bearing the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front, and also sent a letter to Bayan pleading for the altars and the people.
s0012.idiomatic: Song again sent investigating censor Liu Bi with the Song sovereign's vassalage memorial to the army front and a letter to Bayan pleading for the altars and the people.

s0013.literal: On bingzi day the officers and soldiers under Qorudai who had campaigned against Jiandu were rewarded with silver, paper currency, and brocade robes.
s0013.idiomatic: On bingzi day officers and soldiers under Qorudai who had campaigned against Jiandu were rewarded with silver, paper currency, and brocade robes.

s0014.literal: On dingchou day Song dispatched commander-in-chief Hong Mo bearing letters from Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others, requesting to wait until the clan elder, Prince of Fu, arrived and then go together to the army front.
s0014.idiomatic: On dingchou day Song sent commander-in-chief Hong Mo with letters from Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others, asking to wait until the clan elder, Prince of Fu, arrived and then come together to the army front.

s0015.literal: On wuyin day Bayan led the army out of Jiaxing Prefecture, leaving wanhu Huduhu and qianhu Wang Tulincha to garrison it.
s0015.idiomatic: On wuyin day Bayan marched out of Jiaxing Prefecture, leaving wanhu Huduhu and qianhu Wang Tulincha to garrison it.

s0016.literal: Liu Hanjie remained pacification commissioner of that prefecture.
s0016.idiomatic: Liu Hanjie remained pacification commissioner of the prefecture.

s0017.literal: On xinsi day the Yunnan branch secretariat was ordered to supply bows and arrows to the Jiandu garrison army.
s0017.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Yunnan branch secretariat was ordered to supply bows and arrows to the Jiandu garrison army.

s0018.literal: The army halted at Chongde County; Song dispatched Vice Minister Liu Tingrui and commander-in-chief Hong Mo to welcome it.
s0018.idiomatic: The army halted at Chongde County; Song sent Vice Minister Liu Tingrui and commander-in-chief Hong Mo to welcome it.

s0019.literal: Song Du of the Grand Marshal's Headquarters at the march reported: "Although Longxing, Jianchang, Fuzhou, and other Jiangxi prefectures have submitted, Fujian and Guangdong prefectures still resist with arms; we beg for additional troops to advance and subdue them.
s0019.idiomatic: Song Du of the grand marshal's headquarters at the march reported, "Although Longxing, Jianchang, Fuzhou, and other Jiangxi prefectures have submitted, Fujian and Guangdong prefectures still resist with arms; we beg for additional troops to advance and subdue them.

s0020.literal: " An edict granted four thousand Xiang-Han troops for him to command.
s0020.idiomatic: " An edict granted four thousand Xiang-Han troops for him to command.

s0021.literal: On renwu day the army halted at Chang'an garrison; Dong Wenbing came with troops to join.
s0021.idiomatic: On renwu day the army halted at Chang'an garrison; Dong Wenbing came with troops to join.

s0022.literal: Song's Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others broke the agreement and did not come.
s0022.idiomatic: Song's Chen Yizhong, Wu Jian, and others broke the agreement and did not come.

s0023.literal: On guiwei day the army halted at Linping garrison.
s0023.idiomatic: On guiwei day the army halted at Linping garrison.

s0024.literal: On jiashen day it halted at Gaoting Mountain; Alaghan came with troops to join.
s0024.idiomatic: On jiashen day it halted at Gaoting Mountain; Alaghan came with troops to join.

s0025.literal: The Song sovereign dispatched his Baokang Army commissioner Yinpu and He Prefecture defense commissioner Jifu and others, bearing the dynastic jade seal and surrender memorial to the army front.
s0025.idiomatic: The Song sovereign sent his Baokang Army commissioner Yinpu and He Prefecture defense commissioner Jifu and others, bearing the dynastic jade seal and surrender memorial to the army front.

s0026.literal: The text read: "Great Song sovereign Zhao Xian, reverently bowing one hundred times, presents this memorial to the Sage Emperor of Great Yuan, benevolent, clear, divine, and martial: Your subject earlier dispatched Vice Minister Liu Yue and remonstrance officer Hong Leizhen bearing a memorial to hasten to the court threshold, respectfully expressing humble sincerity, trusting it has reached the sacred ear.
s0026.idiomatic: The text read, "Great Song sovereign Zhao Xian, bowing one hundred times, presents this memorial to the Sage Emperor of Great Yuan, benevolent, clear, divine, and martial: Your subject earlier sent Vice Minister Liu Yue and remonstrance officer Hong Leizhen with a memorial to the court, humbly expressing our sincerity, trusting it has reached Your sacred ear.

s0027.literal: Your subject is young and unfledged, his house beset by many troubles; the power-holder Jia Sidao broke the alliance and misled the state — your subject could not know in time. When troops were raised to demand accountability, the altars were imperiled and the people deserved pity.
s0027.idiomatic: Your subject is young and unfledged, his house beset by troubles; the power-holder Jia Sidao broke the alliance and misled the state, and your subject could not know in time. When troops were raised to demand accountability, the altars were imperiled and the people deserved pity.

s0028.literal: Your subject and the retired emperor daily feared and worried; it was not that we did not wish to move the capital to seek mutual preservation — truly the lives of millions were entrusted to your subject's person. Now that Heaven's mandate has found its place, whither should your subject go?
s0028.idiomatic: Your subject and the retired emperor feared daily; it was not that we did not wish to move the capital to preserve both sides — truly the lives of millions rested on your subject. Now that Heaven's mandate has found its place, whither should your subject go?

s0029.literal: Only the heirloom seal of our lineage — we dare not cherish it — we respectfully obey the retired emperor's command, painfully lowering ourselves, stripping the imperial title, and with the Two Zhes, Fujian, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, the Two Guangs, and Sichuan with whatever prefectures and districts still hold, we reverently offer all to the sacred court, praying for mercy for altars and people.
s0029.idiomatic: Only the heirloom seal of our line — we dare not keep it — we obey the retired emperor's command, humbling ourselves, stripping the imperial title, and with the Two Zhes, Fujian, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, Hunan and Hubei, the Two Guangs, and Sichuan with whatever prefectures and districts remain, we offer all to the sacred court, praying for mercy for altars and people.

s0030.literal: We pray the sacred compassion will show pity: the Grand Empress Dowager is aged, bedridden these many years; your subject is alone in grief — the feeling deserves compassion. We cannot bear that our Zhao ancestors' three hundred years of altars should suddenly perish; grant measured disposition and specially preserve us. The regenerating virtue of the Great Yuan Emperor — then the Zhao descendants will rely on it generation after generation and dare not forget.
s0030.idiomatic: We pray Your sacred compassion will pity us: the Grand Empress Dowager is aged and has lain ill these many years; your subject stands alone in grief — the feeling deserves compassion. We cannot bear that our Zhao ancestors' three hundred years of altars should suddenly perish; grant measured disposition and preserve us. The regenerating virtue of the Great Yuan Emperor — then Zhao descendants will rely on it for generations and dare not forget.

s0031.literal: Your subject is overcome with gratitude toward Heaven and longing toward the Sage — urgent and trembling beyond measure.
s0031.idiomatic: Your subject is overcome with gratitude toward Heaven and longing toward the Sage — urgent and trembling beyond measure.

s0032.literal: Bayan, having received the surrender memorial and jade seal, again dispatched Nangadai with Zhao Yinpu, Jia Yujing, and others back to Lin'an to summon the grand councilors forth to discuss surrender.
s0032.idiomatic: Bayan, having received the surrender memorial and jade seal, again sent Nangadai with Zhao Yinpu, Jia Yujing, and others back to Lin'an to summon the grand councilors to discuss surrender.

s0033.literal: On yiyou day the army halted fifteen li north of Lin'an; Nangadai and Hong Mo came with zongguan Yin Jun to report that Song's Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong had seized Princes Yi and Guang and fled out Jiahui Gate, crossing the Zhe River to escape; only the Grand Empress Dowager and the reigning sovereign remained in the palace.
s0033.idiomatic: On yiyou day the army halted fifteen li north of Lin'an; Nangadai and Hong Mo came with zongguan Yin Jun to report that Song's Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong had seized Princes Yi and Guang, fled out Jiahui Gate, and crossed the Zhe River to escape; only the Grand Empress Dowager and the reigning sovereign remained in the palace.

s0034.literal: Bayan urgently sent word instructing Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and Fan Wenhu to lead the armies first to seize and hold Qiantang Crossing, and sent five thousand picked troops to pursue Chen Yizhong and others; they crossed the Zhe River but could not overtake them and returned.
s0034.idiomatic: Bayan urgently instructed Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and Fan Wenhu to lead the armies first to seize Qiantang Crossing, and sent five thousand picked troops to pursue Chen Yizhong and others; they crossed the Zhe River but could not overtake them and returned.

s0035.literal: On bingxu day Bayan issued orders forbidding soldiers to enter the city; violators would be punished by military law.
s0035.idiomatic: On bingxu day Bayan ordered that soldiers were forbidden to enter the city; violators would be punished by military law.

s0036.literal: Lu Wenhuan was dispatched bearing a yellow proclamation to reassure military and civilians inside and outside Lin'an, ordering them to remain settled as before.
s0036.idiomatic: Lu Wenhuan was sent with a yellow proclamation to reassure military and civilians inside and outside Lin'an, ordering them to remain settled as before.

s0037.literal: At the time Song's Three Offices guard soldiers killed people in broad daylight; Zhang Shijie's personal troops were especially overbearing in the lanes, and common people seized the moment to rob and kill.
s0037.idiomatic: At the time Song Three Offices guard soldiers killed people in broad daylight; Zhang Shijie's personal troops were especially overbearing in the lanes, and common people seized the moment to rob and kill.

s0038.literal: When the order was issued, the people were greatly pleased.
s0038.idiomatic: When the order went out, the people were greatly pleased.

s0039.literal: Bayan also dispatched pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, planning commissioner Sun Dingheng, Nangadai, and Hong Junxiang into the palace to reassure Grand Empress Dowager Xie.
s0039.idiomatic: Bayan also sent pacification commissioner Cheng Pengfei, planning commissioner Sun Dingheng, Nangadai, and Hong Junxiang into the palace to reassure Grand Empress Dowager Xie.

s0040.literal: On dinghai day Sayid Ajall of the Yunnan branch secretariat presented the revised designations of Yunnan circuits.
s0040.idiomatic: On dinghai day Sayid Ajall of the Yunnan branch secretariat presented the revised designations of Yunnan circuits.

s0041.literal: He also said that Yunnan's trade differed from the central provinces and that paper currency was truly unfamiliar there; it would be better to allow exchange notes and cowrie shells to circulate publicly and privately, thus conveniencing the people.
s0041.idiomatic: He also said Yunnan's trade differed from the central provinces and that paper currency was truly unfamiliar there; it would be better to let exchange notes and cowrie shells circulate publicly and privately for the people's convenience.

s0043.literal: On wuzi day Central Secretariat officials reported: "Wang Xiaozhong and others, sentenced for crime to go to Badashan to gather precious jade to redeem themselves, passed through Shazhou and encountered the Qocho rebellion; Xiaozhong and others broke free and returned; they are ordered to farm at Guazhou, Shazhou, and other places.
s0043.idiomatic: On wuzi day Central Secretariat officials reported, "Wang Xiaozhong and others, sentenced for crime to gather precious jade at Badashan to redeem themselves, passed through Shazhou and encountered the Qocho rebellion; Xiaozhong and others broke free and returned; they are ordered to farm at Guazhou, Shazhou, and other places.

s0045.literal: Daming Circuit darughachi Xiao Qianbu was executed for corruption after conviction; his household goods were confiscated.
s0045.idiomatic: Daming Circuit darughachi Xiao Qianbu was executed for corruption after conviction, and his household goods were confiscated.

s0046.literal: The Song sovereign's grandmother, Empress Dowager Xie, dispatched her grand councilor Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, pacification commissioner Jia Yujing, and chief eunuch Deng Weishan to meet Bayan at Mingyin Monastery.
s0046.idiomatic: The Song sovereign's grandmother, Empress Dowager Xie, sent her grand councilor Wu Jian, Wen Tianxiang, privy council chief secretary Xie Tang, pacification commissioner Jia Yujing, and chief eunuch Deng Weishan to meet Bayan at Mingyin Monastery.

s0047.literal: Bayan observed Wen Tianxiang's conduct to be irregular and suspected a different intent; he therefore ordered wanhu Mangudai and pacification commissioner Sudu to detain him in the army.
s0047.idiomatic: Bayan saw Wen Tianxiang's conduct was irregular and suspected other intentions; he therefore ordered wanhu Mangudai and pacification commissioner Sudu to detain him in the army.

s0048.literal: Moreover, because their surrender memorial did not style themselves subjects and still used the Song designation, he dispatched Cheng Pengfei and Hong Junxiang together with the envoy Jia Yujing to go again and have it changed.
s0048.idiomatic: Moreover, because their surrender memorial did not style themselves subjects and still used the Song designation, he sent Cheng Pengfei and Hong Junxiang with envoy Jia Yujing to go again and have it changed.

s0049.literal: On jichou day the army halted at Huzhou Prefecture.
s0049.idiomatic: On jichou day the army halted at Huzhou Prefecture.

s0050.literal: Qianhu Nangadai and secretariat clerk Wang You were dispatched bearing the dynastic jade seal to court.
s0050.idiomatic: Qianhu Nangadai and secretariat clerk Wang You were sent with the dynastic jade seal to court.

s0051.literal: An edict ordered Goryeo to send sons of officials with office as hostages.
s0051.idiomatic: An edict ordered Goryeo to send sons of officials holding office as hostages.

s0052.literal: Central Secretariat officials reported: "The old registers of taxed households already had fixed quotas; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan newly canvassed coordinated and merged households numbered 205,180 in all.
s0052.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials reported, "Old registers of taxed households already had fixed quotas; in the seventh year of Zhiyuan newly canvassed coordinated and merged households numbered 205,180 in all.

s0053.literal: " An edict reduced this year's silk levy by half.
s0053.idiomatic: " An edict reduced this year's silk levy by half.

s0054.literal: On gengyin day Bayan raised the grand general's banners and drums and led the left and right wing wanhu in inspecting Lin'an city, viewing the tide on the Zhe River; thereupon Song imperial clansmen and grand ministers came to audience in succession, and at evening he returned to Huzhou Prefecture.
s0054.idiomatic: On gengyin day Bayan raised the grand general's banners and drums and led the left and right wing wanhu to inspect Lin'an city and view the tide on the Zhe River; Song imperial clansmen and grand ministers then came to audience in succession, and at evening he returned to Huzhou Prefecture.

s0055.literal: On xinmao day Zhang Hongfan, Meng Qi, and Cheng Pengfei brought the revised Song sovereign's subject-style surrender memorial to the army front.
s0055.idiomatic: On xinmao day Zhang Hongfan, Meng Qi, and Cheng Pengfei brought the revised Song sovereign's subject-style surrender memorial to the army front.

s0056.literal: On jiawu day Pinggu County of Ji Prefecture was restored.
s0056.idiomatic: On jiawu day Pinggu County of Ji Prefecture was restored.

s0057.literal: Circuit transport commissions were established in each circuit; officials governing the people were also instructed by edict; five hundred troops under Wengjiladai Chouhan were garrisoned at Hada City, six hundred troops under Bujidai were moved to garrison Jiandu, and those of Uryantu and Tanghu previously at Jiandu were all sent back to their wings.
s0057.idiomatic: Circuit transport commissions were established in each circuit, and officials governing the people were instructed by edict; five hundred troops under Wengjiladai Chouhan garrisoned Hada City, six hundred under Bujidai were moved to garrison Jiandu, and those of Uryantu and Tanghu previously at Jiandu were all sent back to their wings.

s0059.literal: Zhending zongguan Shiban was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.
s0059.idiomatic: Zhending zongguan Shiban was made right vice director of the Central Secretariat.

s0060.literal: Second month, on dingyou day, an edict ordered Liu Jie and Cheng Dehui to summon Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui.
s0060.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, an edict ordered Liu Jie and Cheng Dehui to summon Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui.

s0061.literal: On jihai day Linjiang Army was taken.
s0061.idiomatic: On jihai day Linjiang Army was taken.

s0062.literal: On gengzi day the Song sovereign Zhao Xian led the civil and military officials to Xiangxi Hall, faced the court, and presented a memorial above, begging to serve as a vassal assistant;
s0062.idiomatic: On gengzi day Song sovereign Zhao Xian led civil and military officials to Xiangxi Hall, faced the court, and presented a memorial begging to serve as a vassal assistant;

s0063.literal: he dispatched Right Grand Councilor and concurrent Privy Council chief secretary Jia Yujing, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, Hanlin academician and concurrent Privy Council associate Jia Xuanweng, and Hanlin academician and concurrent Privy Council associate Liu Bi to present the memorial.
s0063.idiomatic: he sent Right Grand Councilor and concurrent Privy Council chief secretary Jia Yujing, Privy Council chief secretary Xie Tang, Hanlin academician and concurrent privy council associate Jia Xuanweng, and Hanlin academician and concurrent privy council associate Liu Bi to present the memorial.

s0064.literal: The Song sovereign's grandmother, the Grand Empress Dowager, also presented a memorial and letter.
s0064.idiomatic: The Song sovereign's grandmother, the Grand Empress Dowager, also presented a memorial and letter.

s0065.literal: That day Song's civil and military offices all left Lin'an Prefecture, went to the mobile Central Secretariat, and came to audience each in his office.
s0065.idiomatic: That day Song civil and military offices all left Lin'an Prefecture, went to the mobile Central Secretariat, and came to audience each in his office.

s0066.literal: The branch secretariat, acting on commission, made Lin'an the Two Zhe Grand Commandery; commanders Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered the city to administer affairs.
s0066.idiomatic: The branch secretariat, acting on commission, made Lin'an the Two Zhe Grand Commandery; commanders Mangudai and Fan Wenhu entered the city to administer affairs.

s0067.literal: On xinchou day Bayan ordered Zhang Hui, Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and left and right secretariat officials Shi Tianlin and Yang Hui and others to enter the city, take the counts of military and civilian money and grain, inspect and verify storehouses, collect the patent documents, seals, and tallies of the hundred offices, abolish all Song government offices, and disband and release the palace guard and forbidden armies.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinchou day Bayan ordered Zhang Hui, Alaghan, Dong Wenbing, and left and right secretariat officials Shi Tianlin and Yang Hui and others to enter the city, take counts of military and civilian money and grain, inspect storehouses, collect patent documents, seals, and tallies of the hundred offices, abolish all Song government offices, and disband the palace guard and forbidden armies.

s0068.literal: Song sovereign Zhao Xian dispatched his Right Grand Councilor Jia Yujing and others as supplication envoys to go to court to beg for orders; the Right Grand Councilor ordered Wu Jian and Wen Tianxiang to go together.
s0068.idiomatic: Song sovereign Zhao Xian sent his right grand councilor Jia Yujing and others as supplication envoys to court to beg for orders; the right grand councilor ordered Wu Jian and Wen Tianxiang to go together.

s0069.literal: Bayan and others, right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat, because Song sovereign Zhao Xian had submitted the entire state, presented a memorial of congratulation: the Two Zhe Circuit yielded eight superior prefectures, six prefectures, one army, eighty-one counties, 2,983,672 households, and 5,692,650 persons.
s0069.idiomatic: Bayan and others, right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat, because Song sovereign Zhao Xian had submitted the entire state, presented a memorial of congratulation: the Two Zhe Circuit yielded eight superior prefectures, six prefectures, one army, eighty-one counties, 2,983,672 households, and 5,692,650 persons.

s0070.literal: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials, gentry, military, and civilians of the newly submitted prefectures, districts, and counties of Lin'an, saying:
s0070.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict instructed officials, gentry, military, and civilians of the newly submitted prefectures, districts, and counties of Lin'an, saying:

s0071.literal: Recently the right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat Bayan sent envoys to report that the Song empress dowager, young sovereign, and all ministers and officials on the eighteenth day of the first month presented the seal and cord and submitted a surrender memorial.
s0071.idiomatic: Recently the right chancellor of the mobile Central Secretariat Bayan sent envoys to report that the Song empress dowager, young sovereign, and all ministers and officials on the eighteenth day of the first month presented the seal and cord and submitted a surrender memorial.

s0072.literal: We consider that from antiquity surrendered kings have always had the rite of court audience; We have dispatched envoys specially to go and welcome them.
s0072.idiomatic: We consider that from antiquity surrendered kings have always had the rite of court audience; We have dispatched envoys specially to welcome them.

s0073.literal: Each of you should keep to your occupation; do not rashly give rise to suspicion and fear.
s0073.idiomatic: Each of you should keep to your occupation; do not rashly give rise to suspicion and fear.

s0074.literal: All crimes committed before submission are entirely pardoned;
s0074.idiomatic: All crimes committed before submission are entirely pardoned;

s0075.literal: public and private arrears may not be collected.
s0075.idiomatic: public and private arrears may not be collected.

s0076.literal: Those who resisted the imperial army and those who fled and gathered in bands — their crimes are also pardoned.
s0076.idiomatic: Those who resisted the imperial army and those who fled and gathered in bands are also pardoned.

s0077.literal: Officials of the hundred offices, princely residences, the Three Academies, temples, directorates, the secret archive, the history office, and the forbidden guard offices — each should dwell in peace.
s0077.idiomatic: Officials of the hundred offices, princely residences, the Three Academies, temples, directorates, the secret archive, the history office, and the forbidden guard offices should each dwell in peace.

s0078.literal: In mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes everywhere, apart from great timber and fruit and flowers, the remaining goods are temporarily exempt from tax.
s0078.idiomatic: In mountains, forests, rivers, and marshes everywhere, apart from great timber and fruit and flowers, remaining goods are temporarily exempt from tax.

s0079.literal: Books of the Secretariat, ritual vessels, musical instruments, ceremonial robes, musicians, insignia, and guard units of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, genealogical registers of the Imperial Clan Court, astronomical and geographical maps and registers, and all classical texts and precedents, together with household registers — all are to be gathered and collected.
s0079.idiomatic: Books of the Secretariat, ritual vessels, musical instruments, ceremonial robes, musicians, insignia, and guard units of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, genealogical registers of the Imperial Clan Court, astronomical and geographical maps and registers, all classical texts and precedents, and household registers are all to be gathered and collected.

s0080.literal: Descendants of sages of former ages, eminent Confucians, physicians, monks, Daoists, diviners, those versed in astronomy and calendrics, and reclusive worthies of mountains and forests — the local offices in each place are to report their names.
s0080.idiomatic: Descendants of sages of former ages, eminent Confucians, physicians, monks, Daoists, diviners, those versed in astronomy and calendrics, and reclusive worthies of mountains and forests — local offices in each place are to report their names.

s0081.literal: Famous mountains and great rivers, temples and shrines, and traces of famous men of former ages may not be demolished.
s0081.idiomatic: Famous mountains and great rivers, temples and shrines, and traces of famous men of former ages may not be demolished.

s0082.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves are to receive measured relief.
s0082.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who cannot support themselves are to receive measured relief.

s0083.literal: Bayan thereupon dispatched Song palace eunuch Wang Ye into the palace to collect Song state robes and caps, jade scepters and disks, seals and tallies, and palace registers, treasures, carriages, palanquins, insignia, banners, and other objects.
s0083.idiomatic: Bayan thereupon sent Song palace eunuch Wang Ye into the palace to collect Song state robes and caps, jade scepters and disks, seals and tallies, palace registers, treasures, carriages, palanquins, insignia, banners, and other objects.

s0084.literal: On wushen day the Jiangdong and Jiangxi Pacification Commission was established at Lin'an; Minister of Revenue Mai Gui and Director of the Imperial Library Jiao Youzhi were made pacification commissioners, Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Jukuan was made associate pacification commissioner, and all concurrently served as prefect of Lin'an.
s0084.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jiangdong and Jiangxi Pacification Commission was established at Lin'an; Minister of Revenue Mai Gui and Director of the Imperial Library Jiao Youzhi were made pacification commissioners, Vice Minister of Personnel Yang Jukuan was made associate pacification commissioner, and all concurrently served as prefect of Lin'an.

s0085.literal: On yimao day an edict instructed Huaidong commissioner Li Tingzhi, Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, and officials, military, and civilians of the prefectures, armies, counties, and garrisons under their jurisdiction.
s0085.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict instructed Huaidong commissioner Li Tingzhi, Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui, and officials, military, and civilians of the prefectures, armies, counties, and garrisons under their jurisdiction.

s0086.literal: On dingsi day Jiao Youzhi was ordered to gather forbidden books and registers of the Song Secretariat.
s0086.idiomatic: On dingsi day Jiao Youzhi was ordered to gather forbidden books and registers of the Song Secretariat.

s0087.literal: On wuwu day the former plowing rite was performed at the eastern suburb.
s0087.idiomatic: On wuwu day the former plowing rite was performed at the eastern suburb.

s0088.literal: Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui submitted the Huai-xi prefectures; only Zhenchao Army rebelled again; Gui sent envoys to summon it, and garrison commander Hong Fu killed the envoy; Gui came in person beneath the walls, and Fu then surrendered; Aju executed him in the army.
s0088.idiomatic: Huai-xi commissioner Xia Gui submitted the Huai-xi prefectures; only Zhenchao Army rebelled again; Gui sent envoys to summon it, and garrison commander Hong Fu killed the envoy; Gui came in person beneath the walls, and Fu then surrendered; Aju executed him in the army.

s0089.literal: The Huai-xi Circuit yielded two superior prefectures, six prefectures, four armies, thirty-four counties, 513,827 households, and 1,021,349 persons.
s0089.idiomatic: The Huai-xi Circuit yielded two superior prefectures, six prefectures, four armies, thirty-four counties, 513,827 households, and 1,021,349 persons.

s0090.literal: On gengshen day Bayan was summoned to bring the Song ruler and ministers to court.
s0090.idiomatic: On gengshen day Bayan was summoned to bring the Song ruler and ministers to court.

s0091.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0091.idiomatic: On xinyou day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0092.literal: A precept observance assembly was held at Kaiyuan Monastery in Shunde Prefecture.
s0092.idiomatic: A precept observance assembly was held at Kaiyuan Monastery in Shunde Prefecture.

s0093.literal: Bayan dispatched Bober and Zhou Qing to summon Pu Shougen and Shousheng, brothers of Quanzhou.
s0093.idiomatic: Bayan sent Bober and Zhou Qing to summon Pu Shougen and Shousheng, brothers of Quanzhou.

s0094.literal: On jiazi day Dong Wenbing and Sudu sent Song court literati Liu Baoran and Three Academies students to the capital; Imperial University student Xu Yingbiao and his father and three sons together went to a well and died.
s0094.idiomatic: On jiazi day Dong Wenbing and Sudu sent Song court literati Liu Baoran and Three Academies students to the capital; Imperial University student Xu Yingbiao and his father and three sons together drowned themselves in a well.

s0095.literal: The Emperor, having pacified Song, summoned the Song generals and asked: "Why did you surrender so easily?
s0095.idiomatic: The Emperor, having pacified Song, summoned the Song generals and asked, "Why did you surrender so easily?

s0096.literal: " They replied: "Song had a powerful minister, Jia Sidao, who monopolized state power; he always treated literati generously but alone slighted military officers.
s0096.idiomatic: " They replied, "Song had a powerful minister, Jia Sidao, who monopolized state power; he always treated literati generously but alone slighted military officers.

s0097.literal: We long nursed resentment, our hearts estranged and our strength undone — that is why we offered submission at the first wind.
s0097.idiomatic: We long nursed resentment, our hearts estranged and our strength undone — that is why we offered submission at the first wind.

s0098.literal: " The Emperor ordered Dong Wenzhong to reply: "Even if Sidao truly slighted you all, that is only Sidao's single fault — and what wrong did your sovereign do you?
s0098.idiomatic: " The Emperor ordered Dong Wenzhong to reply, "Even if Sidao truly slighted you all, that is only Sidao's single fault — and what wrong did your sovereign do you?

s0099.literal: If it is as you say, then Sidao's slighting you was indeed fitting."
s0099.idiomatic: If it is as you say, then Sidao's slighting you was indeed fitting."

s0100.literal: Third month, on dingmao day, Associate Privy Council Vice Director Zhang Yi was additionally placed in charge of Director of the Imperial Library affairs.
s0100.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao day, associate privy council vice director Zhang Yi was additionally placed in charge of Director of the Imperial Library affairs.
